_comment: The numbers are the ones the live Supabase project khqqfgqvwdxlqkncwtmh has
today (PostgreSQL 17.11).  They are the contract the rebuilt migration set has
to satisfy when it is applied to a fresh database.
The per-schema breakdown is what the migrations actually create; the flat
counts are the headline numbers printed by `npm run migrate:apply-check`.

public.employee_address.current_primary_.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((is_primary = true) AND (valid_to IS NULL)) THEN (employee_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.employee_assignment.current_prima.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((is_primary = true) AND (end_date IS NULL)) THEN (employee_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.employee_bank_account.active_prim.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((is_primary = true) AND (deleted_at IS NULL)) THEN (employee_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.employee_qualification.active_hig.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((is_highest_qualification = true) AND (deleted_at IS NULL)) THEN (employee_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.student_activity_evidence_version.default:
CASE
    WHEN (is_current = true) THEN (student_activity_evidence_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.student_address.current_primary_s.default:
CASE
    WHEN ((is_primary = true) AND (valid_to IS NULL)) THEN (student_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END

public.user_permission_override.normaliz.default:
CASE
    WHEN (scope_type = ANY (ARRAY['GLOBAL'::text, 'SELF'::text])) THEN (0)::bigint
    ELSE COALESCE((scope_entity_id)::bigint, (0)::bigint)
END

public.user_role_assignment.scope_entity.default:
CASE scope_type
    WHEN 'GLOBAL'::text THEN (0)::bigint
    WHEN 'INSTITUTION'::text THEN (institution_id)::bigint
    WHEN 'CAMPUS'::text THEN (campus_id)::bigint
    WHEN 'DEPARTMENT'::text THEN (department_id)::bigint
    WHEN 'PROGRAMME'::text THEN (programme_id)::bigint
    WHEN 'SELF'::text THEN (user_id)::bigint
    ELSE NULL::bigint
END
